extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for applicants to the William T. rubrics_metrics.name: Field-initiated research
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates funding is available for research projects initiated by applicants (as opposed to foundation-directed projects). No further details on scope, methods, or eligibility are provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Career-development for early-career faculty

rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signifies that proposals focused on supporting the career progression of early-career faculty are within the program's scope. The page does not specify eligibility windows, activities, or evaluation criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional change at universities

rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funds may be directed toward efforts aiming to produce systemic or institutional changes within higher-education institutions. No additional requirements or examples are provided on this landing page.
